description.description:
**tracker portal / tracker** → `tracker_create_work_item`

> Create a work item in the tracker.

Arguments:
```json
{
  "kind": "provision-intake",
  "requestType": "new-data-pipeline",
  "source": "jps-triage"
}
```

Endpoint: `https://tracker.example/mcp`

The server declares this tool read-only, so it runs without approval. That claim comes from the server itself.
